spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अगति)
To wind or move tortuously. See अक.
With an indicatory इ। अगि
(अंगति)
To go, move or approach.

m. (-गः)
1 A tree.
2 The sun.
3 A mountain.
4 A snake.
5 Moving crookedly, twining, twisting.
E.
अ neg. and ग who goes, from गम to go, or अग to go tortuously, अच् aff.

m. (-च्छः)
A tree.
E.
अ neg. and गच्छ, from गम to go.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Mountainous, produced on a mountain.
2 Vegetable, produced from a tree.
E.
अग and ज born.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not to be numbered or reckoned, also अगण्य, अगणितव्य, &c.
E.
अ neg. गणनीय to be numbered.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Not reckoned, uncounted.
E.
अ neg. गणित counted.

m. (-दः)
A medicament, a medicine, a drug.
mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Well, healthy, free from disease.
2 Wholesome, salubrious.
E.
अ neg. and गद disease.

m. (-रः)
A physician.
E.
अगद well, healthy, and कार who makes.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Not to be visited or approached, also अगमनीय, अगम्य, &c.
E.
अ neg. गन्तव्य to be gone.

m. (-मः)
1 A tree.
2 A mountain.
E.
अ priv. and गम who goes.

m. (-मः)
1 Arrival, coming, approach.
2 A Śāstra or work on sacred science in general, supposed to be of divine origin. A Tantra or any work inculcating the mystical worship of SIVA and Ś

AKTI.
4

A grammatical augment, a syllable or letter inserted in any part of the radical word.
5 Record, title deed, legal title, a voucher or written testimony, &c.
E.
आङ before गम to go, to come, अच् aff.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
1 Not to be visited or approached.
2 Difficult of acquirement, unattainable.
3 Unequalled, unsurpassable.
E.
अ neg. गम्य to be gone to.

mfn. (-ग्यः-म्या-म्यं)
1 To be approached, accessible.
2 To be acquired.
E.
आङ् before गम with यत् aff.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Of superior and unequalled form or nature.
E.
अगम्य and रूप form.

f. (-री)
A kind of grass, vulg. Deotar. See देवताड.
E.
अ neg. and गर poison: an antidote.

mn. (-रुः-रु)
Agallochum, (Aquilaria agallocha, Rox.) See अगुरु.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
Modest, humble, void of pride.
E.
अ neg. गर्व्व pride.

m. (-स्तिः)
1 The name of a saint, celebrated in Hindu mythology, more usually entitled AGASTYA, the son of both MITRA and VARUṆA, by URVAŚĪ; he is represented of short stature, and is said by some to have been born in a water jar: he is famed for having swallowed the ocean, when it had given him offence; at his command also, the VINDHYA range of mountains prostrated itself, and so remains; hence his present appellation: he is also considered as the regent of the star

Canopus.
2

The name of a tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)
E.
अग a mountain, and स्ति, with an adventitious meaning, to fix, or in the second instance, to be fixed; also अग as before, and स्ति Uṇādi aff.

m. (-द्रुः)
A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) See अगस्ति.
E.
अगस्ति, and द्रु a tree.

m. (-स्त्यः)
1 The name of a saint.
2 A tree.
3 The star Canopus. See अगलि.

f. (-जा)
A name of PĀRVATĪ, the daughter of the mountain or Himālaya.
E.
अग a mountain, and आत्मजा daughter.

n. (-धः)
A hole, a chasm.
mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Very deep, bottomless.
E.
अ neg. गाध fixed place.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Very deep: see अगाध.

m. (-लः)
A lake.
E.
अगाध deep, जल water.

f. (-ता)
Depth.
E.
अगाध and ता aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Depth.
E.
अगाध and त्व aff.

n. (-रं)
A house. See आगार.
E.
अग a mountain, and ऋ to go; rising like a hill.

n. (-रं)
A house, a dwelling: see अगार.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Arrived, come.
2 Received, obtained.
3 Living or residing in.
E.
आङ् before गम to go, क्त aff.

ind.
Having arrived.
E.
आङ् before गम to go, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-ब्यः-ब्या-ब्यं)
What will come, what is likely to arrive.
E.
आङ् and गम to go, तब्य aff.

mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु)
1 Coming, arriving.
2 Incidental, adventitious.
m. (-न्तुः)
1 A guest.
2 A stranger, a new comer.
3 An accident, any accidental hurt or wound.
E.
आङ् before गम to go, to come, तु affix; म becomes न; also आगान्तु and आगन्तुक.

mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु)
A guest: see आगन्तु.

mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं)
1 Incidental, adventitious, (as pleasure, pain, ornament, &c.)
2 Stray.
m. (-कः)
1 A stranger, a new comer.
2 A guest.
E.
आगन्तु and कन् affix, what comes and goes; what is not inseparably inherent.

n. (-नं)
Arriving, coming.
E.
आङ् before गम to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Independent of a written voucher or title.
E.
आगम and निरपेक्षा disregard.

ind.
Having explored or discovered.
E.
आङ् before गम to go, causal form, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Devoid of a written title or voucher.
2 Without a Śāstra.
E.
आगम and रहित devoid of.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
With or supported by legal vouchers.
E.
आगम and सापेक्ष regard to.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Transient, of short duration.
E.
आगम and अपायिन् separating, going at the time of arrival.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Read over, perused, studied.
E.
आङ् prefixed to गम in the causal form; participial affix क्त.

Sin.
2

Transgression, offence, fault.
E.
आग substituted for इण to go, असुन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
1 Arriving, coming.
2 Future.
E.
आङ् before गम to go, णिनि aff.

m. (-हः)
Arson, setting a house on fire.
E.
आगार and दाह burning.

m. (-ही)
An incendiary.
E.
आगारदाह arson, and इनि aff.
